mainTopic: The opening משנה of מסכת כריתות: the list of the thirty-six sins in the Torah that carry the punishment of כרת, and which קרבנות are brought for them.
overview: The amud opens מסכת כריתות with a משנה listing thirty-six sins in the Torah that are punished with כרת. The list starts with forbidden relationships (עריות). It moves on to sins against ה׳ like עבודה זרה and חילול שבת, then sins involving the מקדש and קדשים, and forbidden foods. It ends with two positive מצוות, קרבן פסח and מילה, where the כרת comes from not doing them. The משנה then gives a general rule for these sins. Done on purpose they bring כרת, done by mistake a קרבן חטאת, and when he is unsure if he sinned at all, an אשם תלוי. רבי מאיר says the only exception is one who makes the מקדש or its קדשים impure, who brings a קרבן עולה ויורד instead. The חכמים disagree and leave out the מגדף as well, because the פסוק about the חטאת speaks of one who does an action, and blasphemy is only speech.

steps.title: Thirty-six כרת sins: the list of forbidden relations
steps.stepSummary: The משנה states that there are thirty-six sins in the Torah punished by כרת. It begins with the forbidden relationships (עריות).
steps.simpleTranslation: There are thirty-six sins in the Torah that carry כרת: relations with one's mother, father's wife, or daughter-in-law; with a male; with an animal (man or woman); with a woman and her daughter; with a married woman; with one's sister, father's sister, mother's sister, wife's sister, brother's wife, father's brother's wife, mother's brother's wife; and with a נדה.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה opens the מסכת by giving a number, thirty-six, and starts listing the sins that carry כרת, beginning with forbidden relationships.
steps.deeperAnalysis: כרת is a punishment from Heaven for doing these sins on purpose. The first group in the list is all עריות, family and other relationships the Torah forbids. The משנה gives a fixed number, and the גמרא will later ask why it bothers to count them.

keyTerms.meaning: Being 'cut off', a punishment from Heaven for certain sins done on purpose
Forbidden relationships
Here: daughter-in-law
A male (relations between two men)
A woman in her monthly period of impurity

steps.confusionAlert: Do not try to make the number thirty-six work by counting on your own yet. Some items are grouped together (like 'a woman and her daughter'), and the גמרא itself discusses why the משנה gives a number at all.

phrases.english: MISHNA: There are thirty-six cases of karet in the Torah:
One who has relations with his mother,
or with his father's wife, or with his daughter-in-law,
one who lies with a male, or with an animal,
and a woman who brings an animal upon herself,

phrases.aramaic: הַבָּא עַל אִשָּׁה וּבִתָּהּ, וְאֵשֶׁת אִישׁ,
phrases.english: one who has relations with a woman and her daughter, or a married woman,

phrases.aramaic: הַבָּא עַל אֲחוֹתוֹ, וְעַל אֲחוֹת אָבִיו,
phrases.english: one who has relations with his sister, or with his father's sister,

phrases.aramaic: וְעַל אֲחוֹת אִמּוֹ, וְעַל אֲחוֹת אִשְׁתּוֹ,
phrases.english: or with his mother's sister, or with his wife's sister,

phrases.aramaic: וְעַל אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו, וְעַל אֵשֶׁת אֲחִי אָבִיו,
phrases.english: or with his brother's wife, or with his father's brother's wife,

phrases.aramaic: וְעַל אֵשֶׁת אֲחִי אִמּוֹ, וְעַל הַנִּדָּה.
phrases.english: or with his mother's brother's wife, or with a menstruating woman.

steps.mimraCoreRuling: There are thirty-six כרת sins; the first group listed is the forbidden relationships.

steps.title: The list continues: sins against ה׳, the מקדש, and forbidden foods
steps.stepSummary: The משנה continues the list with blasphemy, idol worship, מולך, אוב, חילול שבת, impurity and קדשים, forbidden foods, and offering קרבנות outside the מקדש.
steps.simpleTranslation: Also: one who blasphemes, worships idols, gives his children to מולך, practices אוב, or desecrates שבת; an impure person who eats קודש, or enters the מקדש while impure; one who eats חלב, דם, נותר, or פיגול; and one who slaughters or offers a קרבן outside the מקדש.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה keeps adding to the list of כרת sins, now moving from relationships to other kinds of sins.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This group includes sins directly against ה׳‎ (מגדף, עבודה זרה, מולך, אוב, שבת). It then lists sins about purity and the מקדש, and forbidden foods connected to קרבנות. The last two, slaughtering outside and offering up outside, are two separate acts.

keyTerms.meaning: One who blasphemes ה׳'s name
An idol worship in which children were passed through fire
A necromancer, one who claims to raise the dead
Meat of a קרבן left over past its allowed time
A קרבן offered with the intent to eat it after its proper time
Slaughtering or offering a קרבן outside the מקדש

phrases.english: And one who blasphemes, and one who worships idols,
and one who gives of his children to Molekh,
and a necromancer, and one who desecrates Shabbat,
and an impure person who ate sacred food,
and one who enters the Temple while impure,
and one who eats forbidden fat, or blood,
or leftover offering meat, or piggul,
and one who slaughters, or offers up, outside the Temple,

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues the list started in step 1
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Blasphemy, idolatry, מולך, אוב, חילול שבת, impurity with קדשים or the מקדש, forbidden foods, and offering outside the מקדש all carry כרת.

steps.title: The list ends: פסח, יום כיפור, the holy oil and incense, and two positive מצוות
steps.stepSummary: The משנה finishes the list with חמץ on פסח, eating or working on יום כיפור, copying the holy oil or incense, and anointing with the holy oil. It ends with two positive מצוות‎: קרבן פסח and מילה.
steps.simpleTranslation: Also: one who eats חמץ on פסח; one who eats or does work on יום כיפור; one who blends the anointing oil or the incense; and one who anoints himself with the anointing oil. And קרבן פסח and מילה are positive מצוות.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה lists the last items, and points out that the final two are positive מצוות rather than prohibitions.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Every item until now was something you do that is forbidden. קרבן פסח and מילה are different: you get כרת for not doing them. The משנה flags this with the words מצות עשה.

keyTerms.meaning: Leavened food, forbidden on פסח
One who blends (copies the recipe of) the holy oil or incense
The incense used in the מקדש
The holy anointing oil made by משה
A positive מצוה, something you must actively do

steps.confusionAlert: Do not think כרת is only for doing something forbidden. For קרבן פסח and מילה, the כרת comes from failing to do the מצוה.

phrases.english: And one who eats leavened bread on Passover,
and one who eats or does work on Yom Kippur,
and one who blends the anointing oil,
phrases.notes: He means making oil using משה's recipe. שמות 30:22–33

phrases.english: and one who blends the incense,
and one who applies the anointing oil to himself.
And the Paschal offering and circumcision are positive מצוות.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Completes the list of כרת sins
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The list ends with חמץ, יום כיפור, the holy oil and incense, and the two positive מצוות of פסח and מילה.

steps.title: The general rule: כרת, חטאת, or אשם תלוי
steps.stepSummary: The משנה gives one rule for all these sins: on purpose means כרת, by mistake means a חטאת, and when he does not know whether he sinned he brings an אשם תלוי.
steps.simpleTranslation: For all of these, one who sins on purpose gets כרת, one who sins by mistake brings a חטאת, and one who is unsure whether he sinned brings an אשם תלוי.
steps.whatsHappening: Now that the list is done, the משנה explains what follows from doing one of these sins in three different situations.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה ties three outcomes to the person's state of mind: deliberate (זדון), accidental (שגגה), and unsure (לא הודע). An אשם תלוי is a 'hanging' guilt offering. It protects him for now until he finds out whether he really sinned.

keyTerms.meaning: Doing a sin on purpose
Doing a sin by mistake
A sin offering, brought for a sin done by mistake
When it is unknown whether he sinned
A 'hanging' guilt offering, brought when unsure if one sinned

steps.whyThisMatters: This rule explains why these thirty-six sins are listed together in a מסכת about קרבנות: they all share the same system of כרת, חטאת, and אשם תלוי.
steps.whatToRemember: Three levels: on purpose = כרת; by mistake = חטאת; unsure = אשם תלוי.

phrases.aramaic: עַל אֵלּוּ חַיָּיבִין עַל זְדוֹנוֹ כָּרֵת,
phrases.english: For these, one is liable to karet for doing it on purpose,
and to a sin offering for doing it by mistake,

phrases.aramaic: וְעַל לֹא הוֹדַע שֶׁלָּהֶם אָשָׁם תָּלוּי,
phrases.english: and when it is unknown to him, to a provisional guilt offering,
phrases.notes: He's not sure he sinned at all. For example, he ate one of two pieces and doesn't know which one was forbidden.

steps.triggerLanguage: עַל אֵלּוּ חַיָּיבִין עַל זְדוֹנוֹ כָּרֵת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Applies a general rule to the whole list
steps.mimraCoreRuling: For all the listed sins: on purpose means כרת, by mistake means a חטאת, and unsure means an אשם תלוי.

steps.title: The exception: impurity in the מקדש and קדשים uses a sliding-scale offering
steps.stepSummary: The משנה excludes one who brings impurity into the מקדש or to its קדשים from the אשם תלוי rule, because he brings a קרבן עולה ויורד. This is said in the name of רבי מאיר.
steps.simpleTranslation: Except for one who makes the מקדש or its קדשים impure, because he brings a sliding-scale offering. These are the words of רבי מאיר.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה gives one exception to the rule it just stated, and attributes the teaching to רבי מאיר.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Entering the מקדש or eating קדשים while impure still carries כרת, so it stays on the list. But its קרבן works differently: instead of a fixed חטאת, he brings a קרבן עולה ויורד, which depends on how much he can afford. For that reason he does not bring an אשם תלוי when unsure.

keyTerms.meaning: Entering the מקדש or eating its sacred food while impure
A 'sliding-scale' offering that changes based on the sinner's wealth

steps.confusionAlert: This does not mean טומאת מקדש וקדשיו is not a כרת sin. It is still on the list; only its קרבן works differently.
steps.whatToRemember: טומאת מקדש וקדשיו is still a כרת sin, but it gets a קרבן עולה ויורד instead of the usual חטאת, so it has no אשם תלוי.

phrases.english: except for one who defiles the Temple or its consecrated items,
phrases.notes: This points back to two items from the list: entering the מקדש while impure, and an impure person eating קודש.

phrases.english: because he brings a sliding-scale offering,
these are the words of Rabbi Meir.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives an exception to the general rule in step 4
steps.mimraCoreRuling: One who defiles the מקדש or its קדשים brings a קרבן עולה ויורד rather than the standard חטאת, and so does not bring an אשם תלוי. This is רבי מאיר's teaching.

steps.title: The blasphemer is also left out of the קרבן rule
steps.stepSummary: The חכמים say the מגדף is also excluded from the rule of bringing a חטאת or אשם תלוי. The פסוק about the חטאת speaks of one who 'does' a sin, and a blasphemer does no action.
steps.simpleTranslation: And the Sages say: the blasphemer is also left out of this rule. The פסוק says 'One law shall be for you, for one who does by mistake.' That excludes the blasphemer, since he does not do an action.
steps.whatsHappening: The חכמים disagree with רבי מאיר. Besides one who makes the מקדש impure, they say the מגדף also does not bring a חטאת or an אשם תלוי.
steps.deeperAnalysis: According to רבי מאיר, the מגדף, like every sin on the list except טומאת מקדש וקדשיו, brings a חטאת when done by mistake. The חכמים learn from the פסוק's word 'לָעֹשֶׂה', one who does, that a חטאת is only for a sin done with an action. Blasphemy is done only with words, so they leave out the מגדף, even though he is on the list of כרת sins.

keyTerms.meaning: One who blasphemes, cursing ה׳'s Name
'One law', the פסוק that sets one rule for all who sin by mistake
By mistake, without meaning to sin
Literally 'went out': this excludes, this is left out
An action, a physical deed

steps.confusionAlert: 'אַף הַמְגַדֵּף' does not mean the blasphemer also brings a קרבן. It means he is also left out of the קרבן rule, just like the case רבי מאיר left out.
steps.whatToRemember: A חטאת for a mistake is only brought for a sin done with an action. The מגדף sins only with speech, so the חכמים say he brings no חטאת.
steps.whyThisMatters: This sets up a basic idea: a sin that is only speech can carry כרת and still not bring a חטאת for a mistake.

phrases.english: And the Sages say: also the blasphemer,
phrases.notes: He means the blasphemer is also left out of the קרבן rule, just like the case רבי מאיר mentioned.

phrases.english: as it is said: 'You shall have one law'
'for one who does it by mistake'
this leaves out the blasphemer, who does not do an action.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Disputes רבי מאיר's rule in steps 4–5: the חכמים exclude the מגדף as well, while רבי מאיר holds he brings a חטאת and an אשם תלוי.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The מגדף does not bring a חטאת or an אשם תלוי, because the פסוק requires a sin done with an action, and blasphemy is only speech.
